title: Daydream launches AI shopping agent that remembers style, virtually tries on clothes, tracks sales, and completes purchases
content:
X author: @TechCrunch

Daydream released a new AI shopping agent capable of remembering user style preferences, virtually trying on clothes, planning outfits, tracking sales, and autonomously completing purchases.
